period_note: Unaudited interim financial performance, sourced live from DSE's company page (fetched 2026-08-27, same page/method as 2026_Q1.json). Discrete Apr-Jun 2026 and cumulative Jan-Jun 2026 (Half Yearly) both directly reported and reconcile exactly: Q1 (-8.120) + this quarter's discrete EPS (-5.010) = -13.130 = reported Half-Yearly cumulative; diluted continuing-ops EPS likewise reconciles exactly (-3.390 + -2.090 = -5.480). The loss narrowed quarter-on-quarter (Q1 -8.12 to Q2 -5.01 BDT/share) but H1 2026 cumulative is still a loss of roughly BDT -12,359 million (~-1,236 crore) on the same derived-approximation basis as 2026_Q1.json - by far the largest loss (even at the H1-only, un-annualized level) of any period in this dataset's RUPALIBANK series, which otherwise shows only modest quarterly profits (BDT 54-206mn per quarter in 2020-2021) or thin EPS-only positive figures (2023-2025). Q3 2026 has not occurred yet as of the retrieval date - not a gap, a future period. Solo basis presumed per the same caveat as 2020_Q1.json.
